# project conventions (CLAUDE.md):
# Tomorrow — Quick Start for Coding Agents

## Tech Stack
- **Nuxt 3** / **Nitro** / **Vue 3** SFC / **Prisma** / **Supabase** (PostgreSQL)
- **TypeScript** (ES2023, strict mode), **Tailwind**, **Chart.js**, **Zod** validation
- **Tests**: Vitest (run via `npm test`)
- **Node 22.x**

## Directory Map
| Dir | Purpose |
|-----|---------|
| `pages/` | Vue SFC routes (nested = nested routes); `pages/app/` = authed, `pages/` = public |
| `server/api/` | Nitro API handlers; `requireAuth`/`requireVerifiedUser` guard all sensitive routes |
| `server/utils/` | Pure business logic + domain engines; **no I/O, no Date.now()** |
| `server/tasks/` | Nitro cron/scheduled-task handlers (also in vercel.json) |
| `server/plugins/` | Nitro server plugins (KV hydration, DB checks) |
| `components/` | Reusable Vue components; `components/app/` = main UI, `components/ui/` = design system |
| `composables/` | Vue composables (hooks); `useFetch`, `useAuth`, domain-specific |
| `prisma/` | Schema + migrations; **migrations are versioned + checksummed** (never edit applied migrations) |
| `scripts/` | Bash/Node tooling: linters, audits, provisioning (NOT run autonomously) |
| `types/` | Shared TypeScript types |

## Build / Test / Lint
```sh
npm run dev                  # Nuxt dev server (port 3000); env vars from .env
npm run build               # Prod build (runs migrations first if DATABASE_URL set)
npm test                    # Vitest all tests (runs both pure + DB-backed)
npm run lint:migrations     # Verify migration names vs schema (catches naming bugs)
npm run lint:syntax         # Check all .ts/.js syntax (no ts exec)
npx tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck  # Type-check entire project
npx vitest run --config vitest.pure.config.ts  # Pure tests only (no DB)
```

## Code Conventions (Observed, Not Enforced)
- **DB names**: snake_case tables (`@@map("live_clause_edits")`), camelCase columns quoted (`"roomId"`, `"bridgeStatus"`)
- **Code**: camelCase identifiers; PascalCase classes/types; CONST_CAPS for immutable config
- **Migration names**: `20260603000000_feature_name` (timestamp + kebab-case slug); immutable once applied
- **Prisma models**: match schema names; use `@map("col")` on fields only if table uses `@@map`; add `@db.Timestamptz(6)` for dates, `@db.Uuid` for UUIDs
- **Pure functions**: no `Date.now()`, no `Math.random()`, no file I/O—pass time/seed via params
- **Comments**: only document WHY (non-obvious invariants, workarounds); don't comment WHAT
- **Tests**: assert +

```diff
diff --git a/server/api/otc/pricing/cepl-deep-netting.post.ts b/server/api/otc/pricing/cepl-deep-netting.post.ts
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..f1e24a2c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/server/api/otc/pricing/cepl-deep-netting.post.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,78 @@
+import { z } from 'zod'
+import { requireAuth } from '~/server/utils/userAuth'
+import { checkRateLimit } from '~/server/utils/rateLimiter'
+import { withSpan } from '~/server/utils/tracing'
+import { priceLeg, eulerSumCheck } from '~/server/utils/otc/cepl'
+import type { CeplBookEntry, BookPosition } from '~/server/utils/otc/cepl'
+
+const factorExposureSchema = z.object({
+  factorKey: z.string(),
+  sigmaUsd: z.number(),
+})
+
+const ceplLegSchema = z.object({
+  legId: z.string(),
+  contractId: z.string(),
+  counterpartyA: z.string(),
+  counterpartyB: z.string(),
+  primitive: z.string(),
+  jurisdiction: z.string(),
+  maturityYears: z.number().positive(),
+  rate: z.number(),
+  direction: z.enum(['long', 'short']),
+  notional: z.number().positive(),
+})
+
+const bookEntrySchema = z.object({
+  leg: ceplLegSchema,
+  exposures: z.array(factorExposureSchema),
+})
+
+const bookPositionSchema = z.object({
+  positionId: z.string(),
+  exposures: z.array(factorExposureSchema),
+})
+
+const bodySchema = z.object({
+  book: z.array(bookEntrySchema).optional().default([]),
+  newLeg: bookEntrySchema,
+  unifiedPositions: z.array(bookPositionSchema).optional().default([]),
+})
+
+export default defineEventHandler(async (event) => {
+  const user = await requireAuth(event)
+
+  await checkRateLimit('otc-pricing-cepl', String(user.id), { limit: 50, windowMs: 60_000 })
+
+  return withSpan('otc.pricing.cepl-deep-netting', async (span) => {
+    try {
+      const body = bodySchema.parse(await readBody(event))
+      span.setAttribute('book.size', body.book.length)
+
+      const result = priceLeg(
+        body.book as readonly CeplBookEntry[],
+        body.newLeg as CeplBookEntry,
+        body.unifiedPositions as readonly BookPosition[],
+      )
+
+      const eulerCheck = eulerSumCheck(body.book as readonly CeplBookEntry[], body.unifiedPositions as readonly BookPosition[])
+
+      return {
+        pricing: result,
+        eulerVerification: {
+          portfolioEs: eulerCheck.portfolioEs,
+          sumMarginal: eulerCheck.sumMarginal,
+          error: eulerCheck.error,
+          valid: eulerCheck.error < 1e-6,
+        },
+        calculatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
+      }
+    } catch (err: any) {
+      if (err.name === 'ZodError') {
+        throw createError({ statusCode: 400, statusMessage: 'Validation error', data: err.errors })
+      }
+      if (err.statusCode) throw err
+      throw createError({ statusCode: 503, statusMessage: 'CEPL pricing engine unavailable' })
+    }
+  })
+})
```
